# The Q-039 link, with `account:` naming an account the transaction has no
# split on.
#
# What a parked split is worth is read off the split that received the money,
# so the account line is not a label any more — it is where the figure comes
# from. Naming an account the transaction has not got has to be said out loud:
# left to fall through, the settlement would be measured from some other split
# and the reader would never learn which.
#
# `Assets:Bank` exists in this book and is CAD; the money went into
# `Assets:Bank:USD`. That is the likelier typo of the two, and the one a
# reader is least likely to spot by eye.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming the account and the
# transaction.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
invoice "INV-USD-001"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
    memo: "Invoice INV-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-02-25
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank"
    txn_guid: "c9f27c2b2f324117aa17c7c1f48fbafd"
    txn_split_guid: "614b338df4f94c359aa35ffacc2dadcf"
